blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein hai.

items: Woh OOP concept jo data ko class ke andar chhupata hai: (a) Inheritance (b) Polymorphism (c) Encapsulation (d) Abstraction

OOP mein classes aur objects ki sab se achhi tashreeh: (a) Classes asal duniya ki cheezein aur objects methods hain. (b) Classes blueprints (naqshe) hain aur objects un naqshon ke instances. (c) Classes data rakhne aur objects functionality ke liye hain. (d) Objects functionality tay karte aur classes data rakhti hain.

OOP mein encapsulation ka bunyadi khayal: (a) Data class ke andar chhupana aur be-ijazat pohanch rokna. (b) Lachakdar aur dhalne wala program banana. (c) Doosri classes ka code dobara istemal karna. (d) Classes mein multiple inheritance ki ijazat dena.

OOP mein inheritance ka matlab: (a) Parent class se child class tak functionality ka dobara istemal aur izafa. (b) Class mein data chhupana. (c) Aik hi class ke kai instances banana. (d) Classes ka polymorphic behaviour sambhalna.

OOP mein polymorphism ki sab se achhi tareef: (a) Method overriding ke zariye object ka kai shaklein lena. (b) Hifazat ke liye data class mein chhupana. (c) Classes barhane ke liye multiple inheritance istemal karna. (d) Yaqeeni banana ke har object ka sirf aik method ho.

Python mein inheritance ki misal: (a) Milte julte attributes wali do classes banana. (b) Child class ka parent class se attributes aur methods lena. (c) Class ke andar private variables istemal karna. (d) Usi class ke andar method badalna.

Programming mein polymorphism ka maqsad: (a) Kai qism ke parameters wale reusable functions banana. (b) Function ya method ko mukhtalif implementations (kaam ke tareeqe) dena. (c) Mukhtalif classes ko aik class mein jorna. (d) Program ke control flow ko sambhalna.
Python mein class banane ka keyword: (a) def (b) class (c) function (d) object

Encapsulation ki sab se achhi tashreeh: (a) Data aur methods ko aik unit mein jorna aur data tak pohanch control karna. (b) Kai classes ko aik class mein jorna. (c) Doosri classes se methods inherit karna. (d) Objects ko kai shaklein dena.
Inheritance class ko yeh karne deti hai: (a) Sirf apna data chhupana. (b) Doosri class se attributes aur methods inherit karna. (c) Sirf kai functions banana. (d) Class ke baghair objects banana.
